        $this->v = $v % self::$MOD;
        if ($this->v < 0) $this->v += self::$MOD;
    }

    public static function new_unchecked(int $v): ModInt {
        $o = new ModInt(0);
        $o->v = $v;
        return $o;
    }

    public static function zero(): ModInt {
        return self::new_unchecked(0);
    }

    public static function one(): ModInt {
        return self::new_unchecked(1);
    }

    public function is_zero(): bool {
        return $this->v === 0;
    }

    public function add(ModInt $rhs): ModInt {
        $d = $this->v + $rhs->v;
        if ($d >= self::$MOD) $d -= self::$MOD;
        return self::new_unchecked($d);
    }

    public function add_assign(ModInt $rhs): void {
        $t = $this->add($rhs);
        $this->v = $t->v;
    }

    public function sub(ModInt $rhs): ModInt {
        $d = self::$MOD + $this->v - $rhs->v;
        if ($d >= self::$MOD) $d -= self::$MOD;
        return self::new_unchecked($d);
    }

    public function sub_assign(ModInt $rhs): void {
        $t = $this->sub($rhs);
        $this->v = $t->v;
    }

    public function mul(ModInt $rhs): ModInt {
        $v = (int)(((int)$this->v * (int)$rhs->v) % self::$MOD);
        return self::new_unchecked($v);
    }

    public function mul_assign(ModInt $rhs): void {
        $t = $this->mul($rhs);
        $this->v = $t->v;
    }

    public function neg(): ModInt {
        if ($this->v === 0) return self::zero();
        return self::new_unchecked(self::$MOD - $this->v);
    }

        $t = self::one();
        $s = self::new_unchecked($this->v);
        while ($n > 0) {
            if ($n & 1) {
                $t = $t->mul($s);
            }
            $s = $s->mul($s);
            $n >>= 1;
        }
        return $t;
    }

    public function inv(): ModInt {
        if ($this->v === 0) {
            throw new Exception("inv of zero");
        }
        return $this->pow(self::$MOD - 2);
    }

        return new ModInt($val);
    }

            $e->buf[$i * $size + $i] = ModInt::one();

    }

    public function get_mut(int $x, int $y): ModInt {
        return $this->buf[$x * $this->size + $y];
    }

        $this->buf[$x * $this->size + $y] = $v;

        $size = $this->size;

            $buf[$i] = $this->buf[$i]->add($rhs->buf[$i]);

        return new SquareMatrix($size, $buf);
